paragraphs: Rabbi Yehudah ben Yeshayah HaBosem, a Tanna.

Mentioned in [Tosefta Sheviit, chapter 5](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosefta_Sheviit.5.8), [and Tosefta Chullin, chapter 3](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosefta_Chullin.3.3), testifying before Rabbi Akiva in Rabbi Tarfon's name.
We find Rabbi Oshaya, his son, in [Chullin 55b (Hyman cites 55a)](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.55b.14).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Tosefta passages name Yehudah ben Yeshayah as the one testifying before Rabbi Akiva in Rabbi Tarfon’s name.
The linked Bavli names Rabbi Oshaya, son of Rabbi Yehudah HaBasam, as the witness in its account of the ruling about an animal whose hide has been removed.
